598:t_7:13.en:
$$サイアム$$
「If it is you and that boy... and the one guided by Gundam, together with their comrades...」

598:t_7:14.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Then they will surely overcome even the despair that $$フル・フロンタル$$ and I succumbed to.」

598:t_7:15.en:
$$サイアム$$
(Isn't that so, my allies...)

598:t_7:17.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Your Highness... I ask that you tell the truth in your own words... It is our one and only wish... for the people living in this ugly yet lovable world...」

598:t_7:20.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I was not the only one living in the $$宇宙世紀$$ who dreamed of this day that would someday come...」

598:t_7:21.en:
$$サイアム$$
「My allies too have been making preparations for today.」

598:t_7:23.en:
$$ガエル$$
「$$サイアム$$... We are receiving a transmission from $$ナナイ・ミゲル$$ aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

598:t_7:24.en:
$$サイアム$$
「So its system has been activated as well.」

598:t_7:25.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why is the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$...」

598:t_7:26.en:
$$サイアム$$
「It had been decided. That if the day came when someone opened $$ラプラスの箱$$, the truth at its very bottom would be told as well.」

598:t_7:28.en:
$$サイアム$$
「By rights, $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ was supposed to announce it to the people at the dawn of the $$宇宙世紀$$...」

598:t_7:29.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But he fell before his goal was reached, and that secret was buried in darkness along with the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter.」

598:t_7:30.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That is the very truth that shakes this multiverse... every parallel world...」

598:t_7:31.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And it will be released along with $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

598:t_7:32.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Now, let us begin. $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$... and you, $$エルガン・ローディック$$...」

598:t_7:33.en:
$$サイアム$$
(We may well end up bringing despair to this world.)

598:t_7:34.en:
$$サイアム$$
(But let us believe. That the young people who will carry the future will overcome it.)

598:t_7:39.en:
$$トライア$$
「What thoughts do you send out beyond the night sky?」

598:t_7:41.en:
$$トライア$$
「It has been a long time.」

598:t_7:42.en:
$$トライア$$
「I believe the last time we met was at our university graduation...」

598:t_7:44.en:
$$トライア$$
「It took me a great deal of time to track you down, now that you have stepped back from the front lines.」

598:t_7:45.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$カルロス・アクシオン$$.」

598:t_7:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「No... allow me to call you the $$キング$$ of $$クロノ$$.」

598:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As shop owner $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, we will be running the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ under our caretaker service.」

598:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

598:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now then, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

599:t_000:0.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It seems we managed to get ahead of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

599:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's thanks to the two-pronged diversion by $c and the $$プトレマイオス２$$.」

599:t_000:2.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$メガラニカ$$... $$ラプラスの箱$$ is there.」

599:t_001:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You didn't have to come with me. Not you.」

599:t_001:1.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have the right to bear witness too... no, the duty.」

599:t_001:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Got it, $$オードリー$$. I'll never say it again.」

599:t_001:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go. For the future that so many people entrusted to us.」

599:t_002:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You didn't have to come with me. Not you.」

599:t_002:1.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have the right to bear witness too... no, the duty.」

599:t_002:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Got it, $$オードリー$$. I'll never say it again.」

599:t_002:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go. For the future $$マリーダ$$ entrusted to me.」

599:t_003:0.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Our leader and his Guard have reached $$インダストリアル７$$.」

599:t_003:1.en:
$$ヒル$$
「We'll meet $c head-on here. Don't let them through.」

599:t_004:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「It appears $$バナージ$$ and Her Highness $$ミネバ$$ are already inside $$メガラニカ$$!」

599:t_004:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So it's a success so far.」

599:t_004:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「But $$フル・フロンタル$$ is nowhere to be seen among the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.」

599:t_004:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If not even his Guard is here, then he is either holding back in the rear...」

599:t_004:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Then we'll hit the front line and drag those guys out!」

599:t_004:6.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The world $$フル・フロンタル$$ would create... Those who believe in a future where time is as good as stopped...」

599:t_004:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「This battle... So it's the second fight over the $$時の牢獄$$.」

599:t_004:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah! What lies beyond that is the real future!」

599:t_004:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
($$バナージ$$... Leave this to us.)

599:t_004:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
(We're waiting for you and $$ミネバ$$ to grasp the truth.)

599:t_004:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Keep calling out to him, Ensign $$ミヒロ$$. He's sure to be here too.」

599:t_004:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Hold the battle line and wait here for $$バナージ$$! And watch out for reinforcements!」

599:t_004:17.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$ is... close.」

599:t_004:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That man... Does he mean to step into humanity's last fight against itself and stir things up?」

599:t_004:19.en:
$$甲児$$
「He's rotten to the core, that bastard.」

599:t_004:20.en:
$$シモン$$
「Good opportunity. Let's take on $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and him together.」

599:t_004:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack! Here we end the fight with $$ネオ・ジオン$$... the fight between Earthlings!」

599:t_006:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's this... Things aren't very lively here.」

599:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up. We're not risking our lives here to entertain you.」
